rationale: Y covers more of the ground-truth inline concerns: it credits the workdir-arg cleanup, surfaces a real weakness in the qwen-sampling test (probe/decode index mismatch), and flags that both CI gates are red, whereas X mainly hits the validation-order/weak-test concern (well, via a precise note that the fix is correct but the regression test doesn't actually verify call order) but misses the workdir and sampling-test points. Both are well-grounded with file:line evidence and converge independently on the same high-value finding (audio truncation has no content-level accuracy gate) and the shared AAC-priming change, giving comparable precision, but Y is more actionable — concrete code snippets, prioritized numbered items, and claimed local verification runs — while X's bonus 'additional observations' are cut off mid-sentence, hurting usability.
